text: みせの　まえの　ほそいきも　いあいぎりで　きれるんだよ！

structure.jp: みせの　まえの　ほそいきも
structure.en: the thin tree in front of the shop, too

structure.jp: いあいぎりで　きれるんだよ！
structure.en: can be cut with Cut, you know!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, which shows the speaker is explaining how things are. きれるんだ = 'the thing is, it can be cut'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: きる 'cut' changed to きれる means 'can cut' or 'can be cut'. きれる = 'can be cut'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is the tool used to do the action. いあいぎりで = 'with Cut'.
